description: The US stock market on StockMap's map: the 11 sectors, each with its share of the market, its 2-week lean from the model's nightly calls on its stocks, its move on the day and its best and worst stock. A summary, not every stock. Use it when someone asks how the US market looks, or which sectors lead or lag. Its card draws the market as StockMap's heatmap of every sector's biggest stocks, or as bubbles, live in market hours. Each answer carries the not-advice line and the run date.

scope.title: Scope

view.description: How the card draws the market: "map", StockMap's heatmap of every sector's biggest stocks, or "bubbles", the biggest stocks as bubbles sized by market value
